title: Seagrove Beach "The Salty Pelican" 158 Brown Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "The Salty Pelican" 158 Brown Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- New construction- Private salt-water pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day.- 6 adult bikes- 6 seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Snow-bird friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The Salty Pelican is a newly-constructed 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home that sleeps 18 in the highly sought-after Seagrove Beach neighborhood—one of the original 30A communities. With more than 3,100 square feet of living space, guests will love the private salt-water pool, spacious kitchen, and top-floor balcony with great views of the area. It’s a quick 7-minute walk to the nearest beach access!This stunning 2-story home welcomes guests through a vibrant yellow door that opens to the first-floor great room, boasting shiplap walls, hardwood floors, and gorgeous natural lighting. The pristine white kitchen has high-end Thor appliances, spacious countertops, and a large kitchen island that functions as a 5-stool breakfast bar. An adjacent dining area offers ample seating for 8—perfect for hosting an intimate gathering. The living area is designed for relaxation, featuring a plush oversized sectional, matching armchairs, and a 75” TV. A Thor beverage cooler can be found in the corner with a sparkling blue backsplash that adds a pop of color. The back deck has 4 rocking chairs overlooking the private pool with a soothing waterfall and 2 in-pool loungers. The patio boasts a 6-seat alfresco dining table and a convenient propane grill, allowing for seamless outdoor dining experiences. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms on this floor, both with king-sized beds and 50” TVs.Friends and family can retire to the remaining 4 bedrooms spaced throughout the second floor. There is 1 primary bedroom and 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, and 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-full beds and 2 twin trundle beds—all with 50” TVs. The focal point of the second floor is the front balcony, which offers gorgeous views and plenty of seating. There’s also a stacked washer and dryer for added convenience.The Salty Pelican provides everything needed for a memorable and comfortable stay in Seagrove Beach. With on-site parking for 3 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes—plus a 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle—it’s easy to explore the local area. For fun in the sun at Eastern Lake Public Beach Access, head south (left) on Brown Street and continue to Eastern Lake Road. From there, head east (left) until the road starts to curve to the right, and beach access will be on the left-hand side between 471 and 493 Eastern Lake Road. Book this beautiful home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds and Two Twin Trundle Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
